title: Mussels with leeks and parsley
summary: Mussels steamed over softened leek, celery and garlic, with new potatoes in the broth and parsley and lemon at the end.

steps.instruction: Rinse the mussels and discard any that stay open when tapped. Halve the potatoes. Slice the leek, celery and garlic. Stir the stock into the water.
Simmer the potatoes in the stock until they are nearly tender, then lift them out with a slotted spoon and keep the broth.
Warm the oil and cook the leek and celery with a pinch of salt until soft but not coloured.
Add the garlic and chilli flakes and stir for a minute. Pour in the stock.
Return the potatoes, tip in the mussels, cover and cook until they open. Shake the pan once. Discard any that stay shut.
steps.tip: They are done as soon as the shells open. Longer makes them rubbery.

steps.instruction: Take the pan off the heat, stir through the parsley and lemon juice, and serve in warm bowls.
